name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods: bands above the prompt, guards, panes and games.

plugins.name: agent-radar
plugins.description: Live band line per running subagent: time, tool count and what it's doing. /radar shows every agent and its messages.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands and shows what they would change before they run.

plugins.name: browser-lanes
plugins.description: Shows if this session has a Playwright browser and who holds it. /browser clean closes leftover browsers. Subagents take turns.

plugins.name: merge-gate
plugins.description: Holds a merge until CI is green and Codex reviewed once (luna model, Ollama check). PR band and /gate.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: /mission: a live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, and a live code map of the files they touch.

plugins.name: reels
plugins.description: YouTube Shorts in a terminal pane: plays while Claude works, pauses when Claude is done.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the last turn's file edits, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: rulebook-guard
plugins.description: Enforces written rules: no em dashes in prose, asks before --amend, before an unformatted push, and before PII in notes or commits.

plugins.name: session-saver
plugins.description: Names untitled sessions through unpause. /park saves where you left off, and a resumed session shows it.

plugins.name: snake
plugins.description: Snake in a pane while Claude works, paused when it's done. Opt-in: nothing opens until /snake.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A live recap above the prompt: goal, doing now, waiting on you, next. /where for a longer one.
